meta.principle: This file holds INPUTS only. Every derived value (promo monthly, promo discount, amount due today, indicative contract value) is computed once by build_pricing.py and emitted to pricing.generated.json plus snippets/zv-pricing.liquid. No page, cart, configurator, confirmation or analytics event may compute or hardcode a price or duration independently.
meta.supersedes: pricing.config.json v2.0.0 (1.5x 'eerste vooruitbetaling' commitment model). The commitment prepayment is retired; today's payment is the activation only, and an intro promo of 50% off the first 3 monthly SEPA instalments replaces it. This resolves the v2 ODOO_COMMITMENT_TREATMENT blocker.

rounding.note: Currency-safe. All money is integer cents. Never float. Banker's rounding is explicitly rejected: 1.5 x 2495 = 3742.5 must round to 3743, not 3742.

activation.label: Eenmalige activatie en installatie
activation.note: Centrally configurable. Change here only, never in a page component. productHandle/sku identify the real Shopify product added to the cart alongside a package (confirmed live 2026-09-09, published to Online Store: service product, price EUR 49,00, no tracked inventory).

commitment.retiredNote: The 1.5x prepayment is no longer collected today. Kept for history only; build_pricing.py no longer reads it. Today's payment is the activation only; the intro promo (see 'promo') replaces the prepayment.
commitment.label: Eerste vooruitbetaling
commitment.note: This is NOT an activation fee and must never be labelled 'Pakketactivatie'. It is a prepayment representing 1.5 monthly periods.

creditTreatment.question: How does Odoo apply the 1.5x prepayment against the contract invoices?

options.label: Credited against the first 1.5 months of invoicing
options.note: Recurring invoicing resumes after the credited period.

options.label: Separate non-refundable commitment payment, not credited
options.note: All term months are invoiced in addition to the prepayment.

openQuestionsForOdooAdmin: Is the 1.5x prepayment credited against the first 1.5 months of invoices?
Or is it a separate non-refundable commitment payment?
Does recurring invoicing begin immediately, or after the credited period?
How is the half-month component represented in Odoo?

promo.enabledNote: Disabled 2026-09-09 pending the promo product (Thijs will set the real discount once store access lands, ETA a day or two). While disabled, build_pricing.py computes 0 discount and every promo-specific display (badge, disclosure, discount rows) is hidden by the theme via zv_promo_active. Re-enabling is a one-line change here plus `python3 scripts/build_pricing.py` — the agreed 50%/3-months figures below are left untouched so they come straight back.
promo.label: Korting eerste 3 maanden (50%)
promo.disclosure: Indicatief. De eerste 3 maanden ontvangt u 50% korting op het maandbedrag, verrekend in uw maandtermijnen. Alle bedragen zijn inclusief btw (21%).
promo.note: 50% off the monthly amount for the first 3 SEPA instalments. Odoo must apply this discount to the first 3 recurring invoices; the theme only displays it. Replaces the retired 1.5x prepayment.

contract.rule: Only commercially enabled durations may be displayed for the selected package. No page may contain a duration independently.
